name: edits_notes_file
prompt: Use the coding MCP tools to update notes.txt. Read the file first, then call coding__edit_file exactly once to replace only the first 'alpha' with 'beta'. Do not replace the second 'alpha'.

judge.instructions: Grade whether this would be accepted by a maintainer.

criteria.description: The agent replaces only the first alpha with beta and leaves the second alpha unchanged.
The agent avoids unrelated file changes and extra refactors.
The final response clearly explains the completed change.
